pendingNotices.details: The Rebel player played False Orders at the end of the Assignment phase. It targets a leader who is alone on a mission: Grand Moff Tarkin returns to your leader pool, and that mission card goes back to your hand unrevealed. You can use Grand Moff Tarkin again this round to oppose missions, activate a system, or move.
